cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000908
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your collision claim. We are writing to inform you that your claim for coverage is denied.

This decision was reached because the vehicle was being used for paid deliveries while logged into a delivery app at the time of the loss. Your policy includes the following exclusion: "[EXC-2] We will not pay for loss to your covered auto while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee, including while the driver is logged in to a transportation network or delivery platform."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000909
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. At this time, we are unable to provide coverage for this loss.

Our decision is based on the fact that the damage is limited to a mechanical breakdown of the engine, with no collision or other covered event. Your policy includes the following exclusion: "[EXC-1] We will not pay for loss due to and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires, unless the damage results from the total theft of your covered auto."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000910
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your collision claim. At this time, we are denying your request for coverage.

This decision was reached because the policy was cancelled before the date of the incident. According to your policy, "[GEN-1] This policy applies only to accidents and losses that occur during the policy period shown in the Declarations and within the United States, its territories or possessions, or Canada." Because the incident occurred outside of the active policy period, the claim is not covered.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.
